QuestInfo.name: The Mind of a Knight: Beginnings
QuestInfo.1: #p1101002# asked to see you in #m130000000#. Pay him a visit.
QuestInfo.2: You have begun the long journey towards a noble mind; the ultimate virtue for any Cygnus Knight.

0.1: Pay me a visit in Ereve. It's not urgent, but you know how I hate waiting.

yes.0: Superb. I will be waiting for you.

no.0: I'll make sure to note your apathy in my files...

1.0: I see you took my earlier lack of urgency to heart... \r\n#L0##bYou said I had time! What's going on?#l\n#k
1.1: You must learn to read between the lines, if you're going to be a member of this team.\r\n#L0##bWhat team?#l\n#k
1.2: The Cygnus Knights. We require strength, dedication, and a #bnimble mind#k. #h0#, I will expect you to continue on the journey to improve yourself.

yes.0: Remember, see the truth before you.
yes.1: Continue your training. I will call for you when I need you.
